reference: Bambu Studio 2.8.2.61 (v02.08.02.61), its command line on macOS (arm64), made by tests/tools/mac-reference.sh. Projects with a full configuration: BambuStudio --slice <plate> --outputdir <dir> <input>. App-style projects (*.app.3mf, they only name presets): the presets flattened by tests/tools/flatten-presets.py with the project's values in them, then --load-settings machine.json;process.json --load-filaments <filaments> --filament-colour <the project's colours> --slice 0.

cases.name: cube
cases.what: 20 mm cube, P1S 0.4, 0.20mm Standard, full Bambu configuration in the 3MF

cases.name: twocolour
cases.what: two 20 mm cubes on AMS slots 1 and 2: flush, prime tower, 100 tool changes

cases.name: multiplate
cases.what: three plates (two colours; one colour; one colour on the textured plate), --slice 0

cases.name: multiplate-2
cases.what: plate 2 of the same project alone, --slice 2

cases.name: cube.app
cases.what: the cube as the app writes it: preset names (P1S 0.4, 0.20mm Standard @BBL X1C, Bambu PLA Basic @BBL X1C) and the app's values; the engine resolves the presets

cases.name: twocolour.app
cases.what: two colours as the app writes them, no flush matrix: the engine resolves the presets and computes Bambu's matrix from the colours (0,123,471,0)

cases.name: desk.app
cases.what: four-colour desk plate as the app writes it. Not byte-identical to the arm64 CLI (fused multiply-add rounding, as in the spike): config block identical, 11 of 360,000 lines' worth of totals differ in the last digits. The hash is the engine's own (regression); approx compares with the CLI's numbers

cases.name: hook.app
cases.what: support-heavy hook as the app writes it (tree supports). Same caveat as desk.app: config block identical to the arm64 CLI, totals within 0.1 %
